facts.value: Entry clears cmd_vars[1], stores the Master Hand lookup result in x1A5C, and selects motion 0x17A. Anim services and clears a nonzero latch before independently testing a short-circuit disjunction of two boss predicates and animation exhaustion. Exit calls Fighter_UnkSetFlag_8006CFBC, clears x1A5C, and calls ftCh_GrabUnk1_8015BC88. Event and exit may occur together. IASA delegates only for human slots; Phys always delegates once; Coll is empty.
